title: Spectral Decomposition of Discrete-Time Controllability Gramian and Its Inverse via System Eigenvalues
summary: This paper develops a closed-form spectral decomposition framework for the Gramian matrices of discrete-time linear dynamical systems. The main results provide explicit decompositions of the discrete-time controllability Gramian and its inverse in terms of the eigenvalues of the dynamics matrix, yielding a mode-resolved representation of these matrices.
